FABRICATION REQUIREMENTS
JLC04161H-7628 / nominal 1.6 mm / ENIG / green mask
USB differential impedance acceptance: 81-99 ohm
Stencil: 0.100 mm laser cut; J4 shells hand soldered
U1 ground vias: top and bottom tented, no extra apertures
Native 0.010 mm mask and Df 0.02 are visualization defaults only.
Do not use native/Gerber-job default stack metadata as order constraints.
Use reviewed vendor stack and separate recorded USB solver mask model.
